SELECT p.id AS profileId, p.student_id AS studentId, p.section_code AS sectionCode, p.status AS status, p.completeness AS completeness, p.submit_count AS submitCount, p.submitted_at AS submittedAt, p.reviewed_at AS reviewedAt, p.reviewer_id AS reviewerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.student_no), ''), '') AS studentNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.name), ''), ni.value_text, '') AS studentName, AS classCode, c.class_name AS className FROM arc_profile p LEFT JOIN stu_student s ON s.id = p.student_id LEFT JOIN arc_profile bp ON bp.student_id = p.student_id AND bp.academic_year = p.academic_year AND bp.section_code = 'BASIC' LEFT JOIN arc_profile_item ci ON ci.profile_id = bp.id AND ci.field_code = 'basic.classId' LEFT JOIN arc_profile_item ni ON ni.profile_id = bp.id AND ni.field_code = 'basic.name' LEFT JOIN org_class c ON c.class_code = WHERE p.academic_year = #{academicYear}
AND s.status = 1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS profileId, s.id AS studentId, NULL AS sectionCode, 'UNARCHIVED' AS status, NULL AS completeness, 0 AS submitCount, NULL AS submittedAt, NULL AS reviewedAt, NULL AS reviewerId, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.student_no), ''), '') AS studentNo, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.name), ''), '') AS studentName, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.class_code), ''), '未分班') AS classCode, uc.class_name AS className FROM stu_student s LEFT JOIN org_class uc ON uc.class_code = COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(s.class_code), ''), '未分班') WHERE s.status = 1 AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM arc_profile x WHERE x.student_id = s.id AND x.academic_year = #{academicYear} )
mapper.select:
SELECT AS classCode, MAX(c.class_name) AS className, COUNT(DISTINCT s.id) AS studentTotal, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.id IS NOT NULL THEN s.id END) AS archivedStudents, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN p.completed = 1 THEN s.id END) AS completedStudents, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS pendingProfiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'RETURNED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS returnedProfiles, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN p.status = 'DRAFT' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS draftProfiles FROM stu_student s LEFT JOIN arc_profile bp ON bp.student_id = s.id AND bp.academic_year = #{academicYear} AND bp.section_code = 'BASIC' LEFT JOIN arc_profile_item ci ON ci.profile_id = bp.id AND ci.field_code = 'basic.classId' LEFT JOIN org_class c ON c.class_code = LEFT JOIN arc_profile p ON p.student_id = s.id AND p.academic_year = #{academicYear} WHERE s.status = 1
AND c.counselor_user_id = #{counselorId} AND c.status = 1
GROUP BY

SELECT t.profileId, t.studentId, t.studentNo, t.studentName, t.classCode, t.className, t.sectionCode, t.status, t.completeness, t.submitCount, t.submittedAt, t.reviewedAt, t.reviewerId, u.display_name AS reviewerName FROM () t LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = t.reviewerId
ORDER BY CASE t.status WHEN 'SUBMITTED' THEN 1 WHEN 'RETURNED' THEN 2 WHEN 'DRAFT' THEN 3 WHEN 'APPROVED' THEN 4 WHEN 'LOCKED' THEN 5 ELSE 6 END, t.submittedAt DESC, t.studentNo, t.sectionCode LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}
